findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation drops diagnostics whose location is in a syntax tree outside the compilation, and only diagnostics with Location.None or in-compilation locations pass through. Today's security-relevant diagnostics, such as MsgPack analyzers that warn about insecure configuration, are not suppressed by this for in-source types. Metadata-type diagnostics were already deliberately not reported (L8). There is no deserialization-safety regression, because no MessagePackSecurity, depth-limit, or size-check code is touched.

receipt_plan.detail: Read ReportIfLocatedInCompilation: the filter applies only to Diagnostic.Location.SourceTree membership in the compilation. The diff touches no MessagePackSecurity/UntrustedData/MaximumObjectGraphDepth code, so there is no security-relevant change to verify.
